race.comment: CONFORMITY (4) has been in the market at her last couple of starts since resuming but hasn't made an impression, last start running fourth at Eagle Farm. Rates among the leading chances this time. ZOUREKA (8) was found out in Saturday company last start but had won well at the Gold Coast the run prior when leading pillar-to-post over this trip. Not dismissing by any means. BLUE WHITE BLUE (2) has been patchy this prep but can play a minor role on his best figures. BOWDENE (6) was in the firing line on the bend and finished third last time over 1000m at Townsville when resuming from a spell, beaten 1.3 lengths. Meets some better types this time but he has the ability to test this field.
